semiconductor_relevance: High — Obducat Europe specializes in advanced lithography solutions that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Obducat Europe is a leading developer and supplier of nanolithography technologies and equipment used in the manufacturing of micro and nanostructures. Their solutions cater to various sectors, including semiconductors, enabling improved product performance and functionality through innovative lithography processes.
capabilities: Lithography systems for wafer level packaging
Nanotechnology tools for etching and stripping
Foundry services based on in-house cleanroom facilities
